panels.description: Croft appears on a recorded board-and-contract call. His medical-alert bracelet and his son's continuing treatment schedule sit beside the screen. A board message offers CSG the choice to block the interim contract. Leave upper-left clear.
Croft reads the clause. His face remains composed but exhausted; one hand closes around the bracelet. Leave top third clear.
Croft signs a narrow authorization surrendering CSG's exclusive operating frame while allowing the interim public contract to continue. Leave upper-left clear.
The board screen goes dark. Croft remains alone beside the unsigned treatment schedule, indicating continuing critical illness and uncertainty, never death or cure. Leave lower-left clear.

items.text: BOARD MESSAGE: ASSERT PROPRIETARY CONTROL / SUSPEND PUBLIC OPERATION

items.speaker: CROFT
items.text: If I block this, the water stops improving.
CSG WILL NOT BLOCK THE INTERIM PUBLIC CONTRACT
